paite: TOUPA aw, tui thukpi a kipan ka hon sam a,
heading: Panpihna Dia Thumna
english: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA ka aw ngaikhia in; hehpih ka ngetna aw na bil in ngaikhia in.
english: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

paite: TOUPA nang thulimlouhnate na chiamtehleh TOUPA aw, kua adingzouta dia?
english: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

paite: Himahleh na kiang ah ngaihdamna a-om ahi, kihtak a na omtheihna ding in.
english: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

paite: TOUPA ka ngak gige a, ka hinna in angak gige a, athu leng ka lamen ahi.
english: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

paite: Vengmi'n zingsang khovak angaklah sang in ka hinna in TOUPA angaklahzaw hi. Ahi, vengmi'n zingsang khovak angaklah sang in.
english: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

paite: Israelte aw, TOUPA lamen un, TOUPA kiang ah zahngaihna a-om a, amah ah tatna tampi a-om hi.
english: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.

paite: Huchi in ama'n Israelte athulimlouhna tengteng ua kipan ahunkhe ding hi.
english: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
